primary_question: Do jointly preserved and partly independently inherited genetic/developmental resources permit recurrent combinations of Cirsium capitulum phenotypes beyond marginal, pairwise and single-ancestry explanations?

study_design.anatomical_focus: same capitulum: floret pigment, gravity-referenced orientation, phyllary geometry, involucre stickiness/glands, head shape

three_module_theoretical_mapping.observed_surrogate: head orientation in gravity coordinates, developmental trajectory

three_module_theoretical_mapping.empirical_domain: protective involucre geometry and surface apparatus

model_comparison.description: Species/population/ancestry/environment plus module marginals, no co-retention data
M0 plus pairwise module co-retention, allowing correlations/LD
M1 plus directly measured three-way or higher-order functional resource co-retention
M2 plus experimentally supported developmental compatibility, expression and mechanism
Ecological fitness mediation for actual assembled configuration, separate from access

power_precision_precondition.caution: Forty planned individuals across populations are not 40 independent evolutionary origin events; clustering, missing assays, ancestry and ploidy reduce effective sample size.

prospective_sensitivity_scenarios.interpretation: Demonstrations of attainable precision only. No measured ICC, genotype covariance, p_complete, or power approval.

release_conditions: within-population phenotype and molecular coverage adequate
outcome-blind precision and minimum useful effect fixed
all population and genomic ancestries included as controls

nulls.lower_order_moments: complete resource probability may range over Frechet bounds despite fixed first/second moments; do not infer from correlations
nulls.common_ancestry: one genome-wide ancestry gradient generates apparent joint head traits
nulls.phenotypic_coupling: morphological integration without separable genetic resources
nulls.locus_paralogy: similar transcript names are distinct paralogs or alternative splice isoforms, not independent sources
nulls.founder_sampling: rare combinations are lost by bottleneck despite being accessible at broader scale
nulls.hidden_developmental_incompatibility: all required resources coexist but composite head phenotype cannot be expressed
